open_components.gap: assessment_dispute: D-P2-001-GOAL-03 (partial): the translations and equivalences between Hilbert and natural deduction (ND) do not cover the selected ND presentation. The ND-to-Hilbert map thm:p02-w02b-p02-010-nd-to-hilbert and the corollary thm:p02-w02b-p02-010-hilbert-equivalence (1)-(2) are defined and proved only for ND derivations in which every discharge 'applies to all open occurrences of its formula' (parts/p02/axiomatic-calculi-analytic-tableaux-and-refutation-w02b-p02-010.tex:46-55). The Hilbert leg of thm:p02-calculi-derivability-equivalence rests on that corollary (annex/p02/propositional-hilbert.tex:53-63). The annex proof's discharge cases assume 'the sheet discharges every open occurrence of the discharged formula' (annex/p02/axiomatic-calculi-analytic-tableaux-and-refutation-w02b-p02-010.tex:448-452). The selected presentation does not: it discharges exactly the occurrences marked with the rule's label, which 'may be some but not all of the open occurrences' (registry/calculi/nd-cpl.tex:16, 23, 24, 26, 29; restoration/inherited-02193-02340.tex:14-21). No written step translates such derivations into Hilbert derivations, or shows that the full-discharge relation equals Gamma derives_ND_CPL phi. The LK-to-Hilbert map has the same gap: it feeds the sheet:nd-fol tree from annex:p7.calculi.3, which uses label-based discharge, into the full-discharge construction, and asserts without proof that the tree is an ND_CPL derivation (annex .../w02b-p02-010.tex:604-613). Owed: in written steps, the ND-to-Hilbert translation, and hence the ND-Hilbert and LK-Hilbert equivalences, for every derivation of the selected label-based (possibly partial-discharge) ND presentation, with the setting convention changed to match it.
